user_message.content: Can you research how the information that we input is evaluated/verified? Do they perform audits?

status_update.description: Manus is working on your request

assistant_message.content: Researching how the City of Stockton evaluates and verifies business license tax applications, including their audit process. Give me a moment to dig into this.

Here is the full research report. The short answer is: **yes, the City does audit — and the application you submit is explicitly not treated as final.**

Here are the most important things to know:

**The City has broad audit authority.** Under §5.04.180 of the Municipal Code, the Director of Finance can demand to inspect your books and records with just **5 days' written notice**, at any time, to verify the gross receipts figures you reported. All licensees are legally required to permit the examination.

**Your sworn statement is a starting point, not the end.** The code states verbatim that no filed statement "shall be conclusive as to the matters set forth therein." If the City believes a statement doesn't reflect true facts, it can independently estimate the tax owed using external data like tax filings, dividends, or comparable businesses.

**The City is actively doing this now.** The FY 2023–24 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report specifically notes a "gross receipt reporting clean-up of business license data resulting in more accurate and timely billing" — meaning the Finance Department is actively reconciling reported figures against other records.

**Penalties escalate quickly.** Operating without a license triggers an automatic **25% penalty** on top of all taxes, plus **15% per month** (capped at 60%) for delinquency — which is exactly what the penalty calculation in your application reflects.

**False statements carry criminal exposure.** Applications are signed under penalty of perjury. Misrepresenting gross receipts can constitute a misdemeanor under both the City code and California Penal Code §532a(1).

The full report is attached with all Municipal Code citations and references.
